scripts.test:e2e:prepare: bun run build:css && bun run build:web && bun run vendor
scripts.build: bun run --parallel build:css build:web vendor build:bundle
scripts.build:public:prod: bun run --parallel build:css build:web:prod vendor && bun run minify
scripts.build:bundle: bun build --production src/index.ts --target bun --outfile dist/index.js && bun build --production src/server/plugin-runtime/worker-host.ts --target bun --outfile dist/server/plugin-runtime/worker-host.js
scripts.build:web: bun build src/web/shared-ui-settings.ts --outdir public/assets/generated --target browser --format esm --sourcemap=external
scripts.build:web:prod: bun -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('public/assets/generated', { recursive: true, force: true });" && bun build --production src/web/shared-ui-settings.ts --outdir public/assets/generated --target browser --format esm
scripts.build:prod:win: bun run build:public:prod && bun build --production src/index.ts --compile --target bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/overlord-server.exe
scripts.build:prod:linux: bun run build:public:prod && bun build --production src/index.ts --compile --target bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/overlord-server-linux-x64
